what_changed: NCUA proposes removing its regulation on third-party servicing of indirect vehicle loans (12 CFR 701, 741, 746 as cited), described as unnecessarily prescriptive, in favor of principles-based supervision.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; if adopted, federally insured credit unions would no longer be bound by NCUA's specific rule on third-party servicers of indirect vehicle loans, and oversight of such servicers (including an AI servicing vendor) would rest on general safety-and-soundness and vendor due-diligence expectations.
